author: Kickem7709
quote: 30 fps in the big 2026 is insane. The game looks like a slideshow. How did we lose half the frames going from 5 to 6? Utterly unacceptable for a game asking 100 dollars just for all of what should be base game features. Not to mention the gall to not release on PC.

author: Kickem7709
quote: Absolutely phenomenal remake of a classic. While there are myriad changes across the game, everything I noticed was changed felt like it was done with care and remains faithful to the spirit of the original but brought to life in the modern context. Though many of the entertaining and cool glitches from the original are gone, emergent gameplay changes are no reason to detract from the beautifully remastered soundtrack and gorgeous visuals that remain true to the original desings.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
